given: a SKU's detail view is open and its location entries have combined tracking codes recorded
when: the operator reads a location entry
then: that entry shows the record's tracking code

independence.rationale: AC1 covers that the per-location entries (location + quantity) render at all; AC2 covers the distinct outcome that each entry surfaces its tracking code, which can break (code missing from the entry) while the location and quantity still render, and vice versa.
